test_case_name: Access Ryanair Homepage from Cookie Policy and Search for Flights

intents.intent: Click 'Ryanair logo' on the Cookie Policy page
Type $name into 'Departure' input field
Type $name into 'Destination' input field
Click 'Search' button
And then check that the flight search results are displayed based on the entered departure and destination.

test_case_name: Navigate to Cookie Preferences from Cookie Policy and Adjust Settings on Homepage

intents.intent: Click 'Cookie preferences' button on the Cookie Policy page
Click 'View cookie settings' button on the homepage
And then check that the cookie settings modal or page is displayed for user interaction.
